caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair with an ornate design. The chair has a brown wooden frame, with cabriole front legs ending in ball-and-claw feet. The backrest is characterized by an intricate openwork splat with curved and interlacing patterns and a decorative shell motif at the crest rail's center. The seat is upholstered with fabric that appears patterned in shades of blue and red, with hints of green and gold, creating a contrast against the wood. The chair is depicted without any background objects, set against a plain, light beige surface.
title: Side Chair
